Who We Are

Overview. Evergr33n is a community-based enterprise producing high-quality Robusta coffee and black pepper. Rooted in Muguluka village, Jinja District, we combine traditional farming techniques with sustainable practices to produce flavourful, aromatic spices — and a beverage with a genuinely unique taste.

Mission. To uplift rural livelihoods through sustainable farming, providing good-quality Robusta coffee spiced with black pepper and other spices — vanilla, cardamom, and ginger when in season — that reflect the vibrant essence of our region.

Vision. To be a trusted and innovative leader in agricultural production, championing community development and environmental stewardship.

Cup Profile

Tucked away in the family-owned Robusta plantations of Muguluka village: the warmth of ginger, the fire of black pepper, the brightness of cardamom, the soft sweetness of vanilla — a cup that honours the land, the legacy, and the quiet brilliance of sustainable family farming.
